structured_sections.title: OFFICIAL VERIFICATION REPORT: Installation of Community Solar Water Pump in Ward 4
structured_sections.executive_summary: The grant request submitted by Mr. Aarav Sharma (AADHAAR-8921-4321-9988) on 2026-03-15 seeks INR 2,50,000 for the installation of a community solar water pump in Ward 4, under the Rural Water Supply and Sanitation department. All mandatory documentation—including the formal application, Aadhaar identity proof, address proof, sanction order, and community consent resolution—has been provided and positively identified by the automated audit system. The audit confirms complete field coverage, consistent applicant identifiers across documents, and alignment of the sanction order with the requested amount and project scope.
